Commands stop at the first one that fails; nobody answers questions, and there is no editor, so write files with heredocs. The Files section shows, in full, the current contents of every path in `view`: keep the files you need there instead of printing them with cat, and you'll see them after each step's commands run. A non-empty `view` replaces the list; an empty one keeps it. Set `finished` to true, with no commands, only when the task is complete. Every other step must run at least one command: the files in view are already current, so asking to see them again does nothing.
